description: This PHP class defines a custom URL field type for a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module. It extends a base text template to handle URL-specific rendering and processing, including generating HTML input and link display, and default URL handling.

classes.name: TemplateURL
classes.description: A PHP class for managing URL fields within the SuiteCRM framework, providing methods for rendering HTML forms, detail views, and field definitions tailored to URL data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateURL object, setting up variable mappings.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing the URL field as a text input.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Generates HTML anchor tag for displaying the URL link.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the URL in a format suitable for template rendering, prepending 'http://' if necessary.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array including URL-specific attributes like default value, length, database type, and link target.
